# Yahoo Pulse First-run setup

## Purpose
Install Yahoo Pulse: collect fill-ins, prove API quotes + associated news + one chart graphic, then optionally arm a weekday routine.

## Inputs
- `[WATCHLIST]` — comma-separated tickers (required)
- `[BRIEF_TIME]` — weekday local time (optional until routine is wanted)

## Source priority
1. Owner answers in chat
2. Convention memories
Never invent a watchlist.

## Steps
1. Ask only for missing `[WATCHLIST]` and, if they want a routine, `[BRIEF_TIME]`.
2. Write those as convention memories.
3. Confirm source path: free Yahoo chart API first; associated ticker news required; chart PNGs from the same OHLCV; browser last resort. No marketplace plugin or API key required.
4. Dry-prove one ticker: chart API → parse meta + series → 3+ news links → matplotlib (or similar) PNG under `/workspace/yahoo-pulse-charts/` → write `/workspace/yahoo-pulse-YYYY-MM-DD.md` → attach PNG in chat. Change nothing external.
5. Show the dry brief. Ask before creating any routine.
6. If confirmed, create one weekday morning routine at `[BRIEF_TIME]` in the recipient’s local timezone that runs Watchlist brief (no-data silence, no off-chat send).

## Validation
Dry brief has sourced price URL, at least one news link or explicit news gap, and one chart PNG built from API data (or explicit chart gap). Routine not created before confirm.

## Output
Memories set; dry-brief path; chart path; routine created or deferred.

## Failure
API/news/chart fail → report gaps and stop inventing. Do not enable routine on a failed dry run.

## Approval
Routine needs owner confirm. Never send the brief outside chat.

## Example correct result
"Stored WATCHLIST=AAPL,MSFT. Dry brief for AAPL: chart API OK, 4 news links, PNG `/workspace/yahoo-pulse-charts/2026-09-05-AAPL.png`. Routine waiting on confirm."

# Yahoo Pulse Watchlist brief

## Purpose
Complete daily or on-demand Yahoo Finance watchlist brief: quotes, associated ticker news, and chart graphics.

## Inputs
- `[WATCHLIST]` from memory or the current message

## Source priority
1. `GET https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/[TICKER]` — price + OHLCV (no API key)
2. Associated news for that ticker (Yahoo news/search for the symbol — required)
3. `v7/finance/quote` or `yfinance` only if chart fails
4. Browser last resort
Never memory prices or headlines.

## Steps
1. Resolve `[WATCHLIST]`. If empty, ask once and stop.
2. For each ticker, call the chart API; capture price, change, %, as-of, request URL, and OHLCV series.
3. Fetch 3–5 associated news items (title, link, time when available). If none, list a news gap for that ticker.
4. Render a chart PNG from the OHLCV into `/workspace/yahoo-pulse-charts/YYYY-MM-DD-[TICKER].png` (matplotlib or similar). Do not invent decorative charts unrelated to the pull.
5. Write `/workspace/yahoo-pulse-YYYY-MM-DD.md` with quote rows, news blocks, chart paths, and gaps.
6. Send an 8–12 line TLDR in chat and attach the chart PNGs. No email/SMS/Slack.

## Validation
Every number and headline has a URL/timestamp. Every chart traces to the same API pull (or gap noted).

## Output
Markdown path + chart PNGs + chat TLDR.

## Failure
Per-ticker API/news/chart failure → gap and continue. All fail → one “no usable quotes” line, not a fake brief.

## Approval
Report only. Off-chat send needs owner approval.

## Example correct result
"AAPL $190.12 (+1.2%) · chart API · 4 news links · PNG attached · gaps: none — full brief `/workspace/yahoo-pulse-2026-09-05.md`"

# Yahoo Pulse Single-ticker check

## Purpose
Quick complete check for one symbol: quote, associated news, and a chart graphic via the free Yahoo query API.

## Inputs
- One ticker from the current message

## Source priority
1. Chart API for quote + OHLCV
2. Associated Yahoo news for that ticker (required attempt)
3. Quote/`yfinance` fallback, then browser
Never memory fill.

## Steps
1. Normalize the symbol; ask once if missing.
2. Call chart API; capture price, change, %, URL, as-of, OHLCV.
3. Pull 3–5 associated news links (or note news gap).
4. Render one PNG chart from OHLCV; attach in chat.
5. Reply with a short sourced card (quote + news bullets + chart). Optionally append to today’s brief file.

## Validation
Quote and each headline sourced. Chart from same pull or gap noted.

## Output
Chat card + PNG; optional file append.

## Failure
Missing source → say so and stop. Do not guess prices or headlines.

## Approval
Report only. No trades, no off-chat send.

## Example correct result
"MSFT $420.05 (−0.4%) as of 9:41am PT · chart API · 3 news links · chart attached"
